name: UniDoor
subtitle: Pre-hung metal clad Door for insulated panels
shortDescription: UniDoor features an integrated three-sided box-section frame for quick and straightforward installation. Suitable for insulated panels, steel-framed walls and masonry applications, it combines durable steel construction, practical sealing and a clean, modern finish.
longDescription: Ready for Installation – The Versatile Steel Door for Insulated Panel Rooms, Cleanrooms, and Steel Frame Buildings. DDA Compatible.Engineered in Australia, the Motisan Steel Clad door is designed with a pre-hung construction that makes installation straightforward and hassle-free. Whether you’re outfitting a cleanroom, insulated panel room, or steel frame building, our door delivers exceptional performance, durability, and ease of installation—all while ensuring DDA compatibility for accessible building design.

features.explain: Integrated box-section frame designed to simplify installation and reduce on-site assembly work.
Suitable for insulated panels, steel-framed walls and masonry walls with thicknesses of 50 mm or greater.
Rebated door leaf with perimeter seals and an automatic drop-down bottom seal to improve airtightness.
Wind performance certification to AS/NZS 1170.2:2021, subject to the certified configuration and installation requirements.
Galvanised steel door leaf and frame with a UV-resistant powder-coated finish.
Single and double door configurations, with optional vision panels, kick plates and colour finishes.

specifications.Wall Compatibility: Insulated panels, steel-framed and masonry walls

whyChoose: At Motisan, we are committed to delivering high-quality, Australian-engineered solutions that not only meet but exceed industry standards. With features like a ready-for-installation pre-hung design and DDA compatibility, our door ensures a secure, efficient, and accessible solution for your facility. Whether upgrading a cleanroom, outfitting an insulated panel room, or constructing a new steel frame building, the Motisan Steel Clad door is built to perform and designed to last.
